securityBoundaries: Digest-bound finite public packet manifest, every packet, integration, artifact QA, model config, mandate, modules, dispatcher and records source. Enumerate paths before target body access; reject F6 and private runtime bodies.

Existing process LITER_LLM_MASTER_KEY preferred. Otherwise read only known secrets.env in memory; literal assignment parser with conventional duplicate last-wins, no shell evaluation. No credential read occurred during preparation. No fallback credential, alternate gateway, setup or service mutation.
Proxy configuration used only for source identity comparison in memory; neither its body nor credentials enter prompts or outputs. Model config stored only as source ref and safe selected identity.

Responses validated before normalization; malformed findings are rejected rather than silently filtered to an empty PASS. Zero findings require nonempty checked_classes. A response containing the gateway credential is discarded.
Raw HTTP errors, completion text, configuration bodies and keys never persist or print. HTTP statuses/request attempt counts and fixed categories are retained.
outputs: findings-NNNN.json normalized findings/checked_classes only, awaiting root screening.
result-NNNN.json immutable per-packet result, source packet ref, actual classification/statuses/attempt count; survives later interruption.
dispatch-coverage.json immutable complete/incomplete dispatch coverage plus all result refs, exact current bindings and limitations. No final kind:review PASS receipt is produced.

exitCodes.0: Every declared packet produced valid normalized findings; review remains unadjudicated even with CRITICAL findings or unknown independence.
exitCodes.2: Unavailable credential/route, rejected output, incomplete packet coverage, invalid input/binding or incomplete scan. No fabricated clean result.

boundedDispatch.retryPolicy: Reuse existing dispatchJudge defaults only: maxAttempts3, initialTimeout300000ms, existing timeout doubling and retry categories. No outer retries, alternate provider or model discovery.
boundedDispatch.freshContext: System diff mandate plus user raw JSON for exactly one packet, no feedback/history/conversation.

proofLimitations: Configured route identity is source evidence; response is not runtime provider self-identification proof.
Complete original producer connection identity is unavailable; model independence remains unverified-producer-unknown. Root handles operator disposition.
Root performs anti-theater/sycophancy screening before surfacing/adjudicating results.

Supervisor fixture coverage does not certify native direct transport; unsigned local darwin-arm64 only; restart unknown/unsupported requires reconciliation; remote/Windows/signing/installed deployment and inherited279-commit baseline remain unverified/excluded.
No network requests, inference, syntax check, tests, build, formatting, artifact QA, review invocation, canonical transitions, config/seal or product changes occurred in this preparation.

This phase driver reuses its lower-level modules while fixing those source-observed wrapper behaviors for the explicit approved review interface.

No existing Node secret loader found in scoped modules; restricted literal parser adapts the documented shell-source convention to Node-only project constraints. Unsupported shell expansions are reported unavailable rather than evaluated.
